contexts.text: By going away about a bow-shot () = a state so far as it was distant from the doctrine of truth... Shot = that it was as far away as possible, as if it were as far as a dart can be let go from a bow: the shot of a bow is here mentioned, because a bow is predicated of the spiritual man, and because he is a shooter of the bow.

A bow = the doctrine of truth; and this from the missiles, arrows, or darts, which = the doctrinal things from which and with which they combat, especially they who are spiritual, and who were therefore called in ancient times shooters of the bow. Illustrated.
He was a shooter of the bow () = the man of the Spiritual Church; as is evident from the signification of a dart, shaft, or arrow, which is truth... or rather doctrinal things. Illustrated.
As many things in the Word have an opposite sense, so have darts, shafts, arrows, a bow, and a shooter; and they = falsities, the doctrine of falsity, and those who are in falsity. Illustrated.
To shoot in secret at the upright; suddenly will they shoot at him ().
They make ready the arrow upon the string, to shoot in very darkness those who are right in heart ().
The weapons of hunting, which were quiver, bow, and arrows = the doctrinal things of truth. References.
Hence the sons of Ephraim are called shooters with the bow ().

They shoot () = that they combat from (falsities). To shoot = to combat from falsities; for a bow = doctrine, and the darts or missiles, those things which are of doctrine; thus truths of doctrine with those who are in truths, and falsities of doctrine with those who are in falsities: the reason to shoot here = to combat from falsities, is that it here treats of those who are in falsities.
Or in shooting he shall be executed with darts () = that spiritual good would also perish. To be executed with darts = to perish as to spiritual good; for a shooter of the bow = the spiritual man.
If a shooter, or marksman, should aim at a target... and should err in his aim by a finger's breadth, at the end of a mile the dart or ball would depart very far from the line.
Arrows, darts, and shafts = the truths of doctrine which combat. Illustrated.

Combat against evils and falsities, is described by the daughters shall exasperate him, and they shall shoot, and the archers shall hate him: daughters = those who are in evils, and, through falsities, want to destroy goods; those who assault through evils are signified by they will shoot; and those who do so through falsities of evil, by the archers who will hate him. AE 448:6.
Ephraim = the understanding of truth, and his sons, truths themselves, wherefore they are called shooters of the bow, that is, fighters against evils and falsities.
